steps.title: Set up Android project
steps.description: The initial setup of the Android project with specified SDK versions and Gradle configuration.

steps.title: Create MainActivity layout
steps.description: Design the user interface for the main activity, including buttons to start and stop the edge lighting service.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity logic
steps.description: Add Java code to MainActivity to handle button clicks, request `SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW` permission, and manage the lifecycle of the `EdgeLightingService`.

steps.title: Define EdgeLightingService
steps.description: Create the `EdgeLightingService` class, which will run in the background and manage the drawing of the edge lighting effect.

steps.title: Implement EdgeLightingView for drawing
steps.description: Create an inner `EdgeLightingView` class within the service responsible for drawing the animated edge lights on the screen.

steps.title: Add color animation to EdgeLightingView
steps.description: Implement the logic within `EdgeLightingView` to cycle through colors and animate the edge lighting effect.

steps.title: Configure service lifecycle in EdgeLightingService
steps.description: Manage the `WindowManager` to add and remove the `EdgeLightingView` when the service starts and stops.

steps.title: Declare service in AndroidManifest.xml
steps.description: Add the `EdgeLightingService` declaration to the `AndroidManifest.xml` so the system can recognize and run it.

steps.title: Request SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW permission
steps.description: Ensure the application requests and handles the `SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW` permission, which is required for drawing over other apps.

steps.title: Building EdgeLightingApp
steps.description: Compile and assemble the final APK for the Edge Lighting App.
